premises.text: Hair styling is important for self-expression but the industry is not online, making stylists hard to find
premises.evidence_span: the industry isn't online, and so it's hard to find a stylist

premises.text: Independent beauty professionals lack websites, CRM, marketing email, online schedules, and business insight
premises.evidence_span: She has no insight or measurement into her business, and so she can't take an active role in growing it

premises.text: StyleSeat gives professionals online visibility, booking, CRM, marketing, education, and growth dashboards
premises.evidence_span: Now Glenda has direct access to her schedule for the first time. She has all her client information in one place. She can send marketing emails to them

premises.text: Clients discover, filter, book, and share professionals online with reminders and recommendation prompts
premises.evidence_span: I can also book a last minute appointment within the next 24 hours if I like

premises.text: Freemium free booking and scheduling makes the platform available industry-wide
premises.evidence_span: We have freemium model, free online booking, free scheduling, so we're available for the entire industry

value.text: Bring the hair industry online so professionals grow and clients book easily
value.evidence_span: StyleSeed is bringing this $40 billion industry online starting today

secondary_value.text: Redirect inefficient marketing capital in the beauty market
secondary_value.evidence_span: unlock $18 billion in inefficiency in the space

notes: Independent run3: folded website/social/dashboard/apps into one professional-tools premise (v1.3.2 4.1(5)). $18B inefficiency kept as secondary_value criterion rather than premise. Traction excluded.
